Patna NSUI Clash : patna ke kangres karyalay men kursi vivad ko lekar jamkar hangama huaa. aarop hai ki NSUI ke sadasyon ne midiya karmiyon ke sath gali-galauj, badasluki aur marpit ki. bataya ja raha hai ki baithne ke lie kursi ko lekar shuru huaa vivad dekhte hi dekhte barh gaya aur patrakaron ke sath dhakka-mukki ki naubat aa gaee. aakhir kangres karyalay men kya huaa? dekhie puri khabra.
